events.summary: Started implementation of the frozen inspection platform architecture with manifest-driven Shopify inspection, platform capability registry, plugin contracts, checkpoints, artifact index, dashboard model, and Inspection Report export.

Implemented rendered page capture as a bounded platform capability: Playwright-driven capture of rendered search result pages and visible autocomplete dropdowns with retained screenshots, exposed through the rendered-search plugin and compared against endpoint evidence.
events.motivating_context: Operator asked to close the rendered-evidence gap that kept every inspection partial and blocked non-Shopify targets per decision 3A.
